description: This file handles bulk editing and saving of Purchase Order records in vtiger CRM. It retrieves a list of record IDs, permits editing permitted records, updates their fields with provided data, and redirects back to the module's main page.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: CRMEntity class instance used to interact with CRM records.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Populates the entity object with data for a specific record ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current state of the entity object back to the database.
